name: Wheel list
what: A list on a wheel: items roll up past the middle one at a time; the current one bold and dark, the rest smaller and fainter with distance, like a phone's picker.

learned_from.what: the centre line, the fade with distance, a roll every ~1 s (an S-curve over ~10 f at 25 fps)

motion: in 16 f (rise), a roll every hold + 12 f (S-curve), the bold copy cross-fades
